scope: Native geometry preparation and R8-preserving model wrapper, called directly and through recovered particle callbacks; original full-state/boundary comparisons and independent matrix-vector algebra.
limitations: Model traversal 8c62113c is an explicit fixture; no actual rendering, pixels, GPU/MMIO or full frame-order proof.
Finite scalar arithmetic uses existing helpers and independent Python dyadics. Guard/trap classification uses native probes; hardware exception dispatch and arbitrary pointers remain outside scope.
Inherited shared vector numerical oracle limits; wide-FMOV modes use constructed data and do not establish normal gameplay reachability.
